title: Anti-government and chief-prosecutor campaign begun July 9, 2020
february_observations: 2021-02-07: Bgonair identifies the government-resignation protest as the 214th campaign day (BG2102-S011).
BNR described a 215th consecutive evening of anti-government protest; the article page date is unverified (BG2102-S003).
2021-02-19: BNR reports the 226th consecutive day and a declaration with 33 demands for politicians seeking future office (BG2102-S006).
notes: The July 9, 2020 start comes from prior-unit body consultation BG2102-S008, which carries its source lineage explicitly. Bgonair describes the February 7 event as campaign day 214, and BNR describes February 19 as day 226. The separate BNR report calls an event the 215th consecutive evening but its publication/event date was not verified. February reports establish continued campaign activity. Do not treat this campaign as a single continuously assembled event; keep separate assemblies granular and do not transfer campaign turnout or responses. The announced later 18:30 march on February 19 was future at report time and is not coded as executed from that announcement.
